code_scope: New opt-in research package and immutable sidecar. No model inference, shared-card activation, wagering or production database.

test_execution.test_population: Synthetic engineering fixtures, no predictive sports evaluation

closed_findings.finding: Engine dose float incompatible with strict persistence serializer
closed_findings.closure: Integer zero output; actual decide_payload→SQLite evaluation passes.

closed_findings.finding: SQLite authority constraint permitted NULL from absent field
closed_findings.closure: IS false constraint; raw missing/null/string/true authority inputs rejected.

closed_findings.finding: Near-half-point Decimal rounded into supported half-point at ambient precision
closed_findings.closure: Explicit precision256 exact boundary validation; positive and negative adversarial cases reject.

closed_findings.finding: Model-bound game-state timestamp could follow model cutoff
closed_findings.closure: state_time<=cutoff required; retained adversarial fixture refuses.

closed_findings.finding: CLI did not enforce postwrite audit verification and malformed root could bypass receipt
closed_findings.closure: Explicit audit/checkpoint checks and invalid-root wrapper; actual subprocess fixtures produce auditable BLOCKED.

reviewed_properties: Signed favorites/underdogs use opponent-minus-selected margin; region dominance equals exhaustive integer test.
Quantity-level fees/minimum/upward rounding, tier crossing and strict total-EV buffer preserve decimal arithmetic.
Caller flags are engineering assertions only. Evidence bridge ignores authority assertions and has no provider/qualification authority.
Bound state, model, quote, rules, fee schedule and configuration hashes retained. Matching supplied bytes does not authenticate their contents.
Actual SQLite transactions/idempotency/rollback/concurrent writers exercised; rows append-only through ordinary SQL and replacement attempts.
External checkpoint required to detect deletion of complete audit history; administrator protection not claimed.
Joint-scenario parlay expectations use supplied correlated mass; no multiplication of marginal probabilities or automatic selection.
Contract sidecar copies exact bound sources, records writer time/observed checkout, refuses overwrite, never emits order authority.
limitations: Reported external 51-test and 28-test packages were not recovered; these results concern new repository implementation.
PostgreSQL migration is static candidate only; no PostgreSQL adapter, transaction/concurrency run or production schema mapping.
No verified venue fee/rule schedule, quote authentication or qualified valuation registry. Operational sidecar remains BLOCKED.
Pure core can label caller-asserted engineering fixture QUALIFIED_CANDIDATE but explicitly production_eligible=false and order_authorized=false.
Binary half-point $1 contracts only for comparator/decision path. Sportsbook pushes/quarter lines/live state are not enabled.
Parlay half wins/losses, cashout, correlated probability generation and automatic selection remain unsupported.
No accuracy-first ranker altered; fees/EV do not increase confidence. No deployment, model promotion or predictive validation.
